About "Bicycle front wheel":

  • Blender: 2.79
  • Render Engine: Cycles
  • Uploaded on: 2018-09-15 04:45:02
A bike front wheel. It started as a modelling exercise, as I wanted to see how exactly are the spokes mounted. I ended up modelling the whole whell. Maybe when the summer is gone I will do the rear wheel as well ;-)For the sample render I used the Paul Lobe Haus from Hdri Haven. I made the dirt and the mask textures with GIMP.I hope someone will find it useful.

derived_observations.measurement_frame: Wheel root local frame, meters; world original preview is tilted and translated, so world AABB cannot represent tyre diameter/width.
derived_observations.spoke_count_evidence: Four source spoke meshes, each Array count=9, merge disabled; each source mesh contains spoke body and nipple as two disconnected components.
derived_observations.rim_profile_notes: Raw modeled profile and evaluated positive-radial section are stored; width/depth are mesh envelope values. No ISO bead-seat or effective rim diameter semantic metadata is present, so BSD/ERD are not confirmed.
derived_observations.hub_flange_notes: Raw polygon vertices have two flange slabs at +/-31.25..33.25 mm; pitch circle / manufacturer hub model / disc mount / OLD not semantically specified.
derived_observations.root_pivot_relation: Axle, hub, rim, four spoke meshes, tyre share central origin; valve is independently located. No wheel rotation constraints/drivers found in the inspection report.
source_adaptation_limits: Tyre approx 706.59mm max radial diameter and 41.47mm width differs from requested nominal 698mm/38mm
No rotor or identified disc-mount assembly among wheel children
High evaluated triangle count requires rebuilt arrays/subdivision or retopology
Source wheel root is posed flat/tilted in original scene; must remap axes and origin
500 micron Solidify rim skin is visualization geometry and not a manufacturing wall specification
derived_observations.appropriate_use: CC0 source for spoke J-bend/nipple, hub flange, tyre and rim topology methods, valve detail. Not a dimensional reference for Giant stock wheel.
derived_observations.root_animation_note: FrontWheel has Action RuotaAction; no Drivers or constraints on wheel component objects. Measurements are at source scene frame 10.
